scope.description: Eligibility of the local-only ReadOnlySafe shortcut after a fully applied leader-to-learner demotion, with StepDownOnRemoval disabled.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine peers and immutable unique IDs.
Configuration change is committed using the prior configuration and applied in order.
Caller persists Ready state before sends and calls ApplyConfChange before Advance.
Read request uses a fresh unique context; no incoming voter message is delivered after invocation.
excluded: A requirement that every read must complete.
Global linearizability endpoint without a separate observed client history.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target edits. Host state machine stores the last nonempty normal entry as a diagnostic value.
Network isolation is modeled by dropping inter-node messages; no messages or votes are fabricated.
RawNode.Status and Ready.ReadStates are observational APIs; CA_EVENT records host scheduling and output.

plan_uncertainties: The checked proposition is local read-support eligibility, not a measured client linearizability endpoint.
No crash persistence or asynchronous-storage ordering is exercised.
An initial common snapshot substitutes bootstrap prehistory; all histories material to demotion and reads execute.
